channel.title: PAGASA MINPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA MINPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 01:00 PM 14 November 2026

Light to Moderate rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #DavaoCity, #DavaoDelSur(SantaCruz, CityOfDigos, Bansalan), #DavaoDelNorte(CityOfSamal), #DavaoDeOro(Pantukan and Mabini) within the next 1-2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #MINPRSD
Issued at 09:30 AM 14 November 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #DavaoOccidental, #DavaoDelSur, #DavaoOriental, #DavaoDelNorte, #DavaoDeOro, #DavaoCity, #Bukidnon, #MisamisOccidental, #LanaoDelNorte, #MisamisOriental and #Camiguin within 12 hours.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 05:00 AM 14 November 2026

Light to Moderate rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #SurigaoDelNorte(SanFrancisco, Placer), #SurigaoDelSur(Hinatuan, Lanuza) and #AgusanDelSur(Loreto).

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity, Sison and TaganaAn) and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 8 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 8 FINAL #MINPRSD
Weather System: Easterlies
Issued at 08:00 PM 13 November 2026

All Rainfall Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #MINPRSD
Weather System: Easterlies
Issued at 05:00 PM 13 November 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rains are expected over #ZamboangaDelSur(Dumingag, Sominot, Labangan, PagadianCity, Tigbao, Kumalarang, Margosatubig, VincenzoA.Sagun, SanMiguel, Dimataling, Guipos), #ZamboangaSibugay(Kabasalan, Buug, Diplahan, Siay), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Liloy, Sirawai, Siocon, Baliguian), #AgusanDelSur(Rosario, Bunawan, Trento, SantaJosefa, Veruela, Loreto, LaPaz, SanLuis, Esperanza, Sibagat), #SurigaoDelSur(Tagbina, Hinatuan, CityOfBislig, Lingig, SanAgustin, Marihatag, SanMiguel), #DavaoOriental(GovernorGeneroso, SanIsidro, CityOfMati, Caraga, Baganga, Boston, Cateel), #DavaoDeOro(Mawab, NewBataan, Nabunturan, Compostela, Montevista, Monkayo, Laak), #DavaoDelNorte(CityOfSamal, CityOfTagum, Carmen, CityOfPanabo), #DavaoOccidental, #Sarangani, #Bukidnon(Maramag, CityOfValencia, Lantapan, Pangantucan), #TawiTawi, #DavaoCity, #SouthCotabato, #DavaoDelSur(Malalag, Kiblawan, Sulop), #Camiguin, #MisamisOriental(Balingasag, Lagonglong, Salay and Binuangan) within the next 2-3 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are being experienced in #ZamboangaSibugay(RosellerLim, Tungawan, Titay, Ipil, Naga), #SurigaoDelSur(Lianga, Barobo), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Godod, Tampilisan, Kalawit, Gutalac, Sindangan, LeonB.Postigo, Siayan, Labason, Salug), #ZamboangaDelSur(Midsalip, Bayog, Lakewood, Lapuyan), #AgusanDelSur(CityOfBayugan, Prosperidad, SanFrancisco, Talacogon), #DavaoOriental(Tarragona, Banaybanay, Lupon, Manay), #DavaoDeOro(Pantukan, Mabini, Maragusan and Maco) which may persist within 2-3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 08:00 PM Today.
